caption: The drawing features a central, large, shaded depiction of a pitcher or jug with a pronounced curved body, a wide opening at the top, and a narrow base that flares out slightly at the very bottom. The jug has a large, curved handle attached from the top rim to the midsection, curving outwards and down with a curled tip at the bottom. The entire object is rendered in gray graphite pencil on a light beige background, with areas of soft shading to suggest volume and contours. Surrounding the main drawing are four smaller, lightly drawn diagrams in each corner, each enclosed in a square. The top left corner shows a side view of the jug with proportions labeled, the bottom left depicts a top-down view showing the circular rim and handle placement, the top right provides a detailed profile of the handle with measurements, and the bottom right shows a cross-sectional view of the jug’s wall with vertical proportions. Some measurements and notes are written near the diagrams, and the word "MEYERS" is inscribed near the bottom left, followed by “Scale 1 in.” The entire composition is symmetrical and technical in nature, focused on presenting the dimensions and form of the jug in a precise and informative manner.
title: Pewter Mug
